verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a team inbox and collaboration product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Missive. The only related evidence describes a hosted service, with a community note that emails are fetched through Missive's servers. Hosted API, MCP access and custom MCP connections are adjacent integration features, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
